instruction: Insert one new section titled 'Weekly view interactions' into the root README.md, at heading level ## , positioned after the existing ## Features block (which ends with the 'Things you can't do in Compass (yet)' list) and before ## Tech stack. The section contains exactly three bulleted blurbs in this order: (1) Multi-day select - describe moving an EXISTING event across days by dragging it, and stretching an EXISTING event across several days by dragging its edge; link to ./docs/frontend/week-drag-interaction.md. NEVER state or imply that dragging empty all-day space creates a multi-day event - that capability does not exist on this branch. (2) Recurring events - describe choosing edit/delete scope (this occurrence / this and following / whole series); link to ./docs/acceptance/recurring-events.md framed as how the behavior is verified, not as a feature guide; do not state how many scenarios it contains. (3) Event colors - describe assigning a color to an individual event from the event form and it showing on the event's chip in the grid, and that leaving it unset follows the calendar's default appearance; no link; NEVER name an individual color or state how many colors exist. Match the README's existing end-user tone and its '- **Lead-in** - prose' bullet style. Summarize and link out; keep each blurb to roughly one to three sentences. Change nothing else in the file.

inputs.content:
## Features

Cool things you can do with in Compass

- Find the perfect slot for an event with your keyboard: `SHIFT` + `↑` `↓` `←` `→`
- Do everything from the cmd palette
- Edit events smoothly
- Google Calendar sync

Things you can't do in Compass (yet):

- See attendees, reminders, locations, and meeting links
- See your Outlook events

## Tech stack
